profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Manage your personal account details.
profile.languageHelp: Changes how HRHandle looks for you. Doesn't affect what candidates or teammates see.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication policy
mfa.subtitle: Require members of your organisation to enroll a TOTP authenticator. Only the owner can change this policy.
mfa.requireAllHelp: Every member, including owners and admins, must enroll before they can use HRHandle.
mfa.requireAdmins: Require 2FA for owners and admins only
mfa.saved: Policy saved. Members will be prompted to enroll on their next page load.

aiFit.title: AI Fit Analysis
aiFit.subtitle: An optional, advisory copilot that assesses how an application fits a vacancy's scorecard criteria. Only the owner can change this setting.
aiFit.enableHelp: Adds a collapsed advisory card to each candidate profile. It never scores the person, never advances or rejects anyone, and hides the candidate's name and other protected details from the model.
aiFit.acknowledgement: I understand AI Fit Analysis is advisory only: it produces no overall score, a human always makes the decision and must record an assessment, and outputs are based only on job-relevant evidence. Under the EU AI Act this is a limited-risk, human-in-the-loop use and my organisation acknowledges these terms.
aiFit.onNotice: AI Fit Analysis is on. Recruiters will see the advisory card on candidate profiles.
aiFit.offNotice: AI Fit Analysis is off. The card is hidden everywhere.
